corpus.note: Public reading list is a curated subset; full ~400-paper corpus used in Shen et al. 2024 is not publicly available as a structured ID list

hardware.gpu_info: 5x NVIDIA H100 NVL (not used - CPU-bound API pipeline)

reality_check.reason: No ML model used - deterministic API pipeline

training_sufficiency.reason: No training loop - data infrastructure pipeline

findings.corpus_limitation: Public reading list repo contains ~130 linked papers with extractable IDs, not the full 400-paper corpus from the systematic review
findings.coverage_borderline: 67.3% coverage just below 70% gate - non-systematic dropout (ACM DL papers lack arXiv IDs)
findings.classification_scheme_sensitivity: Scheme1/2 classify only 4 papers (HCI-dominated corpus with few NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR papers); Scheme3 (FoS-primary) classifies all 33
findings.cross_group_edges_low: 9 cross-group edges found (scheme3) vs 30 gate - within-corpus citation graph is sparse given small corpus size
